header.title: Al Sudais Indonesia Foundation
header.desc: Al Wafi Islamic Boarding School - International Sunnah Boarding School with Holistic, Harmony, and Exemplary concepts

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: Every child is smart and has different potential intelligence depending on how the educational environment can bring out the intelligence of each child. Al Wafi Islamic Boarding School was established to provide assistance to students according to their interests, talents and intelligence based on the values of Al-Quran and Sunnah.
intro.p2: Parents want the best education for their sons and daughters and we at Al Wafi Islamic Boarding School are an international standard sunnah boarding school ready to form a generation that has noble character.
intro.p3: Al Wafi Boarding School is here with the hope of providing comprehensive (holistic) and aligned (harmony) education and providing a model or example by integrating various curricula including diniyah curriculum, national curriculum of Al Quran and sunnah, science and technology as well as lifeskill content.
intro.p4: With the boarding school system (islamic boarding) and supported by professional teaching staff, high dedication, foreign teachers (native), alumni from the Middle East and teachers from State University graduates will lead students to get education at the desired campus.
intro.p5: We at Al Wafi IBS believe that the best education cannot be realized without the support of parents and students' families. Therefore, communication networks and student information services are one of our priorities.

history.p1: Al Wafi Boarding School is here to meet the needs of the community who want modern international standard Islamic education. Al Wafi Boarding School was built on a land area of 3,405 M² with parcel number 23.D.I Kohir No. 964, land survey letter Gs. No. 1186/1977.
history.highlight_part1: The groundbreaking for the construction of SMP and SMA Al Wafi Islamic Boarding School was carried out by the Governor of West Java Mr. Ahmad Heryawan on Friday,

header.title: SDTQ Al Wafi
header.desc: Al Wafi Quran Tahfidz Elementary School - A-accredited Sunnah elementary school with a holistic curriculum and Islamic values reinforcement

intro.p1: SDTQ AL Wafi (Al Wafi Quran Tahfidz Elementary School) is a sunnah elementary school under the auspices of the Bina Wafi Indonesia Foundation. Located in Depok, this school has been accredited A by the Depok City Education Office.
intro.p2: SDTQ AL Wafi uses the Education Office, Diniyah, and Al Qur'an curriculum, and provides reinforcement in Arabic and English. The school also instills Islamic values in accordance with the teachings of Salafus Sholih, creating a holistic learning environment oriented towards Islamic values.

concepts.title: Collaboration and Communication
concepts.approach: Building an environment that supports cooperation between students through group assignments, class discussions, and collaborative projects.
concepts.activities: Conducting educational games that require cooperation, such as group puzzles, and quiz competitions. In addition, using technology such as online discussion forums
concepts.goals: Developing effective social and communication skills, as well as teaching the importance of helping and supporting each other

concepts.title: Morals and Independence
concepts.approach: Instilling Islamic values and ethics through role models and direct learning
concepts.activities: Carrying out daily activities such as congregational prayers, reading hadith, and exemplary stories of Prophet Muhammad PBUH. Giving small responsibilities to students, such as maintaining class cleanliness and picket duties
concepts.goals: Forming student characters with noble character and independence, and able to be responsible for their actions

concepts.title: Love of Learning
concepts.approach: Creating a fun learning environment and fostering curiosity.
concepts.activities: Using project-based learning methods and simple science experiments. Utilizing the school library and multimedia learning resources
concepts.goals: Instilling a love of learning and knowledge exploration, and encouraging students to continue learning throughout their lives

concepts.title: Every Child Has Different and Unique Intelligence
concepts.approach: Using a learning approach that is in accordance with Howard Gardner's multiple intelligences
concepts.activities: Identifying the dominant type of intelligence of each student and arranging varied activities, such as music, sports, art, and motor skills. Providing time for exploration of individual interests and talents
concepts.goals: Respecting and developing the unique potential of each child, and maximizing their abilities in various fields

concepts.title: ALICI (Active Learning and Islamic Character Integrated) Learning Method Approach
concepts.approach: Combining active learning with strengthening Islamic character.
concepts.activities: Implementing activity-based learning (active learning) that involves students directly in the learning process, such as role-playing, simulations, and interactive discussions. Applying the habituation of Islamic values through daily activities, such as prayer together before and after studying, and moral studies every week
concepts.goals: Increasing student active participation in learning and forming a strong Islamic character

tahfidz.title: Quran Tahfidz
tahfidz.desc: This program is the core of education at SDTQ AL Wafi, which aims to develop students' ability to read, memorize, and understand the Al-Qur'an properly and correctly. This program includes various structured activities to ensure optimal student tahfidz development. The method used is Iqro' Ustmani

programs.title: Tasmi'
programs.description: Tasmi' is an activity where students recite their Al-Qur'an memorization in front of a teacher or examiner. This activity is carried out regularly to monitor the progress of student memorization and ensure good memorization quality

programs.title: Quran Halaqoh
programs.description: Quran Halaqoh is a group study session where students are guided by ustadz or ustadzah in reading and memorizing the Al-Qur'an

programs.title: Joint Examination with Masayikh
programs.description: This exam is a tahfidz evaluation carried out with Masayikh (scholars or professors) to assess the extent of students' memorization and understanding of the Al-Qur'an

programs.title: Monthly Murojaah
programs.description: Monthly Murojaah is an Al-Qur'an memorization revision activity carried out every month. The goal is to ensure that the memorization that has been learned remains strong and is not forgotten

programs.title: Tahfidz Camp
programs.description: Tahfidz Camp is an intensive program held in the form of camping or outdoor activities that focus on improving Al-Qur'an memorization

header.desc: Global education program to broaden students' horizons through direct learning in countries with strong Islamic education traditions

vision.title: Overseas Vision

list: To be an educational center providing deep understanding of the importance of Al-Quran as a source of knowledge and Arabic as a tool to understand it, and its application in daily life.
